newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, MAY 13 - THURSDAY, MAY 15.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, MAY 13 - THURSDAY, MAY 15.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-233/94 Germany v/ Parliament and Council: free movement of persons. Annulment of Council directive 94/19/EEC of the European Parliament and Council of May 30, 1994, on deposit guarantee systems. - Opinion C-353/95 P Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission: state aid. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber enlarged), rendered September 18, 1995, in case T-471/93, Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission. Refusal to annul Commission decision of January 18, 1993, rejecting the complaint of the claimant under EC treaty article 92 and 93. - Opinion joined cases C-359/95 P, C-379/95 P Commission v/ Ladbroke Racing: competition. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber enlarged), rendered September 18, 1995, in case T-548/93, Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission. Refusal to annul Commission decision of January 29, 1993, rejecting the complaint of Ladbroke Racing Ltd - Paris, on horse racing. Pari mutuel urbain. - Oral procedure C-317/95 Canadanc Cheese Trading: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. National regulations reserving the traditional denomination "feta" to cheese satisfying certain conditions relating to its composition and mode of fabrication. - (1130/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-15/96 Schoening-Kougebetepoulou: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 48 and of article 7, paragraphs 1 and 4 of Council regulation 1612/68, of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the community. Collective convention for workers in the public sector providing for automatic promotion after a certain period of activity within the framework of said convention, excluding the taking into account, among other things, of public sector activity in another member state.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure joined casses T-28/95, T-110/95, T-133/95, T-204/95 IECC v/ Commission: competition. Appeal for incompetence aimed at having it noted that the Commission illegally abstained from taking a position on the complaint submitted by the claimant on the basis of EC treaty articles 85 and 86 on hindrances imposed on "remail" practices resulting from the actions of the postal administrations of certain member states.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases T-70/92, T-71/92 Florimex v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of July 2, 1992, communicated by letter No. SG(92)D/8782, rejecting a complaint by the claimant that gave rise to an application procedure for EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Flower trade. - Judgment T-77/94 VGB and others v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of July 2, 1992, communicated by letter of December 20, 1993, rejecting a complaint by the claimant that gave rise to an application procedure for EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Flower trade.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-250/95 Futura Participations: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 52. National legislation on income tax subjecting the application of provisions concerning the reporting of losses by non resident taxpayers firmly established in the member state concerned to the condition that these losses relate to indigenous income and that accounts be properly kept and conserved within the country. - Judgment C-355/95 P TWD v/ Commission: state aid. Appeal against court judgment (third chamber enlarged) rendered September 13, 1995, in joined cases T-244/93 and T-486/93, TWD v/ Commission. Rejection of action for annulment against decisions 91/391/EEC and 92/330/EEC on aid granted by the German government to the claimant company insofar as it constrains German authorities to suspend the payment of said aids until repayment of previous aids granted and declared incompatible with the EC treaty. - Opinion C-54/96 Dorsch Consult: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 1 of Council directive 89/665/ECC of December 21, 1989, on the coordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions relating to the application of review procedures to the award of public supply and public works contracts, as amended by article 41 of Council directive 92/50/EEC of June 18, 1992, on coordination procedures for public procurement supply contracts. Determination of the national instance charged with examining actions provided for by Council directive 92/50/EEC in the absence of a national act of transposition. - Opinion C-409/95 Marschall: social policy. Interpretation of article 2 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Obligation to give a promotion to a female candidate in a category of "male dominated" jobs where her qualifications, aptitudes and performances equal those of a competing male, except when there are particular motivating factors relating to said male candidate. 121209 DED:BC-DIARY-COURT =2 Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2)

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-405/95 Bioforce: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Common Customs and Excise Tariff - NC 1994 - positions 3004 (medicines) and 2208.9069 (other alcoholic beverages). Extracts of Echinacea purpurea, leaves and roots, with added alcohol intended for preventative use against chills and grippes. - Opinion C-17/96 Badische Erfrischungs-Gertraenke: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 80/777/EEC OF July 15, 1980, on the approximation of member states' legislation on the exploitation of and trade in natural mineral waters. Notions of "health enhancing properties" and "certain effects". Water whose health enhancing properties are attributed to a low sodium content.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-278/95 P Siemens v/ Commission: state aid. Appeal against court judgment (second chamber) rendered June 8, 1995, in case T-459/93, Siemens v/ Commission. Action for annulment of Commission decision 92/483/EEC of June 24, 1992, on aid granted by the Brussels Capital region (Belgium) in favour of the information processing and telecommunications activities of Siemens SA. Errors in law.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-244/95 Moskof: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Commission regulation 3477/93 of December 17, 1993, on agricultural conversion rates applied in the tobacco sector. Retroactive setting of a fixed ECU-drachma conversion rate for raw tobacco. Adaptation of a specific generating factor for the conversion rates applicable to tobacco harvests before 1993. Consultation with the tobacco management committee. - Oral procedure C-360/95 Commission vl Spain: free movement of persons. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/371/EEC of June 20, 1991, on the application of the agreement between the EU and the Swiss confederation on direct insurance other than life insurance. - Oral procedure C-361/95 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of persons. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/49/EEC of June 18, 1992, on the coordination of member states' laws, regulations and administrative provisions on direct insurance other than life insurance and modifying directives 73/239/EEC and 88/357/EEC. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-384/95 Landboden-Agrardienste: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 6, paragraph 1, 11, part A, point 1(a), 12, paragraph 3(a) and of annex H,, point 1, of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Notion of performing a service. Voluntary limit on the potato harvest on the lands of a taxpayer towards obtaining a grant in favour of more extensive production. Application of reduced tax rate.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-55/96 Job Centre: free movement of persons. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 48, 49, 55, 59, 60, 62, 66, 86 and 90. National law excluding private companies from working placement activities. - Oral procedure C-369/95 Somalfruit: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Compatibility with Council regulation 404/93 of February 13, 1993, on the common organisation of markets in the banana sector with the Lome ACP-EEC convention. Compatibility with regulations 404/93, 1442/93 of June 10, 1993, setting down application measures on community banana imports, and 1443/93 of June 10, 1993, on temporary measures on community banana imports. Bananas from Somalia. - (1100/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-356/95 Witt: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 1765/92 of June 30, 1992, laying down support measures to certain arable crop producers. Limitations on national authorities to determine "production regions" within the meaning of article 3, paragraph 1, first line. obligation to indicate the "determining criterion". Taking into account of soil fertility. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-280/95 Commission v/ Italy: state aid. Non respect. Failure to adhere to Commission decision 93/496 of June 9, 1993, on state aid. Italy (tax credits for professional road hauliers). - (1600/1400 GMT) Oral procedure C-206/96 Commission v/ Luxembourg: environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to execute obligations resulting from Council directive 76/464/EEC of May 4, 1976, on pollution caused by certain dangerous substances dumped in the community's aquatic environment. Non adoption of pollution reducing programmes.
